findings.description: The new call-site comment ("The steer behind Escape is named as pup steer names one (decisions 44, 47).") is a pointer rather than a WHY: the steer action (1292-1295), the interruptSession JSDoc and the new test comment already carry the reason, and AGENTS.md §Comments says to delete the call-site copy when the seam already says it. Drop it, or state the WHY in one line.

The JSDoc addition "as `steerSession`'s record does" is a loose cross-reference (recordSteerMessage is the closer analogue) and doesn't say what omitting `by` means; something like "`by` names who sent the steer; omitted, the record names nobody." would be tighter.
